record_type: post-fix development diagnostic; not a replacement evaluation run
explanation: Recognized recursive tree-generator delegation with yield from. Advancing a yielded value through nested delegating generators can cost O(depth); across all yielded nodes the work is O(sum of node depths), or O(n*h), with O(n^2) worst-case time for a skewed tree and O(n log n) for a balanced tree. This includes delegation inside the generator, not work performed by its consumer, and assumes an ordinary tree without cycles or shared subtrees. Called helper functions are not included; this estimate is not a proof.
note: Post-fix one-case development diagnostic on calibration data. The frozen pre-fix pilot outputs and metrics were not changed; this result is not held-out evaluation evidence.
